description: Use this when someone (often a non-US founder) asks which US state to form their LLC or company in - Wyoming, New Mexico, Delaware, or California. Compares government fees, annual cost, franchise tax, privacy, and approval time, and recommends a state based on their situation.

operates_in_california.description: Whether you (or the business) physically operate in, or are a resident of, California. If true, California registration is generally required regardless of where you form.

priority.description: What matters most: lowest_cost, most_privacy, or investor_ready. Defaults to lowest_cost.

raising_venture_capital.description: Whether you plan to raise venture capital or convert to a C-corp. If true, Delaware is usually preferred by investors.
